python -c '
import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
conn = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/data.sqlite")
for table in pd.read_sql("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=\"table\";", conn)["name"]:
    print(f"Table: {table}")
    print(pd.read_sql(f"PRAGMA table_info({table});", conn))
    print(pd.read_sql(f"SELECT * FROM {table} LIMIT 5;", conn))
    print("\n")
'

python -c '
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/data.sqlite")
tables = conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=\"table\";").fetchall()
for table in tables:
    table_name = table[0]
    print(f"Table: {table_name}")
    columns = conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table_name});").fetchall()
    print([c[1] for c in columns])
    rows = conn.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {table_name} LIMIT 5;").fetchall()
    for row in rows:
        print(row)
    print("\n")
'

python -c '
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/data.sqlite")

q_guidance_upper = """
SELECT 
    (SELECT high FROM guidance WHERE fiscal_period="Q2FY2025" AND measure="GAAP diluted EPS") +
    (SELECT sum(amount) FROM guidance_adjustments WHERE fiscal_period="Q2FY2025" AND item != "Expected favorable currency impact") +
    (SELECT amount FROM guidance_adjustments WHERE fiscal_period="Q2FY2025" AND item = "Expected favorable currency impact")
"""
print("guidance_upper:", conn.execute(q_guidance_upper).fetchone()[0])

q_eps_gap = """
SELECT 
    (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end="2024-11-30" AND months=3 AND measure="Non-GAAP diluted EPS") -
    (
        (SELECT high FROM guidance WHERE fiscal_period="Q2FY2025" AND measure="GAAP diluted EPS") +
        (SELECT sum(amount) FROM guidance_adjustments WHERE fiscal_period="Q2FY2025" AND item != "Expected favorable currency impact") +
        (SELECT amount FROM guidance_adjustments WHERE fiscal_period="Q2FY2025" AND item = "Expected favorable currency impact")
    )
"""
print("eps_gap:", conn.execute(q_eps_gap).fetchone()[0])

q_net_income_adj = """
SELECT 
    (SELECT sum(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end="2024-11-30" AND months=3 AND category="Operating expense") -
    (SELECT amount FROM adjustments WHERE period_end="2024-11-30" AND months=3 AND category="Income tax expense" AND item="Income tax effects")
"""
print("net_income_adj:", conn.execute(q_net_income_adj).fetchone()[0])

q_adjusted_net_income = """
SELECT 
    (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end="2024-11-30" AND months=3 AND measure="Net income") +
    (SELECT sum(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end="2024-11-30" AND months=3 AND category="Operating expense") -
    (SELECT amount FROM adjustments WHERE period_end="2024-11-30" AND months=3 AND category="Income tax expense" AND item="Income tax effects")
"""
print("adjusted_net_income:", conn.execute(q_adjusted_net_income).fetchone()[0])

q_adjusted_net_margin = """
SELECT 
    (
        (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end="2024-11-30" AND months=3 AND measure="Net income") +
        (SELECT sum(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end="2024-11-30" AND months=3 AND category="Operating expense") -
        (SELECT amount FROM adjustments WHERE period_end="2024-11-30" AND months=3 AND category="Income tax expense" AND item="Income tax effects")
    ) / (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end="2024-11-30" AND months=3 AND measure="Total revenues") * 100
"""
print("adjusted_net_margin:", conn.execute(q_adjusted_net_margin).fetchone()[0])
'
